resolutions.title: Approval of Annual Accounts
resolutions.text: IT WAS RESOLVED that the audited financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026 be and are hereby approved for signature by the Chairman.

resolutions.title: Declaration of Dividend
resolutions.text: IT WAS RESOLVED that an interim dividend of £0.50 per Ordinary share be declared and paid to the members on the register as at 1 May 2026.

notes: There being no further business, the Chairman declared the meeting closed at 10:45.
